column2: This is a sheet to calculate and track the total ammo of different guns, based on their magazine stat and their inventory size stat. Go to each tab for different weapons, and please leave a comment if you find an incorrect cell

There's usually a linear relationship between inventory size stat and reserves. this gets shifted depending on the magazine stat, by about a maximum of 5 ammo in either direction. For some weapon types I only have the baseline at 100 mag stat, without the mag-based shifting
Now including Primaries! This tab has accurate mag sizes for all primaries
Database tab contains all gun rolls to search through. Individual Weapon Type tabs are the same info, just pared down
*All except swords, which work differently, so are just on their own tab
